question: Should CodexBar adopt this permanent local Share Stats surface, and should its subscription aggregation become the shared model boundary for this PR and https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2116?
rationale: Source review can assess implementation correctness, but it cannot decide whether menu and Settings sharing belong in the product or which of two parallel branches should own the long-term aggregation contract.

options.title: Approve shared local export
options.body: Keep the menu and Settings entry points, extract or designate one subscription-scoped aggregation seam shared with the companion dashboard, and require real-bundle proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Retain the renderer and exporter but expose sharing from only one existing UI location to reduce permanent product surface.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Do not add a permanent usage-card export and close the draft after preserving any generally useful aggregation work elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve shared local export
recommendation.body: Keep the menu and Settings entry points, extract or designate one subscription-scoped aggregation seam shared with the companion dashboard, and require real-bundle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide product-surface and ownership-boundary decision, and steipete is the repository owner with history in the affected central UI paths.
